g.text: Manually run Terraform Create on develop
Terraform_Plan · validate and save the plan
Terraform_Apply · create AKS and grant AcrPull on the existing ACR
Ansible installs the Helm chart and waits for the FluxInstance API
Create Git SSH and SOPS age Secrets and wait for Ready
Flux deploys Traefik and the rest of the platform
Wait for and validate the public IPv4
The artifact belongs to this FluxCD Ansible run
Download the artifact from the triggering run
Copy traefik.auto.tfvars.json into the dev Terraform root
Cloudflare_Plan uses traefik_public_ip from the artifact
Cloudflare_Apply updates the A record in Cloudflare
Points to the Traefik public IPv4
